title: FLA import: unrecognised class tags and stream truncation cause Magnet.fla to render blank
description: PARTIALLY FIXED as of 2026-06-10 QA run 2: The unrecognised class tag errors (0x2, 0x102, 0x202, 0x204) and stream truncation errors are gone. Stage still renders black — root cause has shifted to SWF encoding errors (see task 0890: DefineShape4 invalid fill style, and 0891: JPEG missing EOI). This task can be closed; remaining black-stage issue tracked under 0890.
